notes: VAT 18% (Tax Code art. 173.1, taxes.gov.az); no investment-gold exemption - only delivery of gold to the Central Bank is zero-rated (art. 165.1.5), so retail bullion and jewellery carry 18%. CBAR bullion coins are sold by agent banks under price caps (sell at most spot +10%, repurchase at spot minus up to 3%); caps are not a dealer list, so premiums are null.

sources.name: State Tax Service (taxes.gov.az) - Tax Code of Azerbaijan, arts. 173 and 165
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28: art. 173.1 VAT shall be 18 percent of each taxable operation and taxable import; art. 165.1.5 zero-rates only the delivery of gold and other valuables to the Central Bank
sources.quote: Article 173. VAT rate 173.1. VAT shall be 18 percent of each taxable operation and taxable import.

sources.name: Central Bank of the Republic of Azerbaijan - Bullion coin sales agents
sources.what: CBAR has issued 999.9 gold bullion coins (1 ounce, 1/2 ounce, 1/4 ounce, 1/10 ounce) since 10 May 2023, sold and repurchased through agent banks Bank of Baku OJSC and TuranBank OJSC. Agents must set the selling price at the limit of 'gold price + 10%' and the repurchase price at 'gold price - up to 3%'.
